people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good except one—God.
translations.bsb: “Why do you call Me good?” Jesus replied. “No one is good except God alone.
translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God.
translations.asv: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good save one, even God.
